@anand\_thakkar1 Mirage captures the rendered DOM as you navigate authenticated flows, creating static snapshots instead of replaying live requests. That means nothing connects to your backend during playback, so no live data or tokens are ever exposed. You give up real request replay, but in return you get isolated, reliable demos that continue working even as your API evolves!
